At run time the rendered value must be relative and every segment must name something: `.` and `..` segments, empty segments (`a//b`, `daily/`), rooted values (`/daily`, `C:/daily`, `C:daily`, `\\server\share`), and `:` anywhere are all rejected. Windows shapes are rejected on every platform, so a pattern is valid everywhere or nowhere. A rejection names the `{filename}` it interpolated, so a colon in the source filename points at itself. children.description: Configuration keys members may not override, as a mapping of key to the value the team pins. A local override of a locked key is rejected.
children.name: locked

children.description: Modules that must be installed on every member machine. A missing one is a compliance failure.
children.name: requiredModules

children.description: Modules members are advised to install. Surfaced in compliance reports without failing them.
children.name: recommendedModules

fields.description: What the team mandates, suggests, and forbids members from changing. Enforced by the generated ConfigPolicy.
fields.name: policy

children.description: Login the member's machine enrolls as. Becomes the name of the generated MachineConfig.
children.name: username

children.description: Public key the member's enrollment request is verified against. Omitted, the member enrolls through the device-flow instead.
children.name: sshPublicKey

children.description: Profile for this member, overriding the team-wide `spec.profile`.
children.name: profile

children.description: Hostname to reconcile this member's machine as, when it differs from the machine's own.
children.name: hostname

fields.description: The people on the team. One MachineConfig is generated per entry.
fields.name: members

name: TeamConfig
